note: Product targets (docs/performance.md, Budgets). Keys are <benchmark>/<metric>; max for costs, min for throughput. Reported by every run; WABCUT_PERF_ENFORCE_BUDGETS=1 fails on an exceeded one. Regressions are checked separately against each machine's baseline.

startup/warm_ms.why: a warm start to an interactive window under 2 s

startup/cold_ms.why: the first start after an install or a cleared cache

startup/recent_project_ms.why: a big last project must not slow the start (it is not opened)
